i10.en: Made for home games and club tournaments. Accurate with the screen off, readable from across the table.
i10.zh-Hant: 為家庭牌局與俱樂部錦標賽設計。螢幕關閉也準確，隔著牌桌也看得清。

i12.en: Pause, resume, or skip levels. The clock keeps time in the background and after a force quit, and picks up where it left off.
i12.zh-Hant: 暫停、繼續或跳過級別。App 在背景或被強制關閉後計時照常，重開就從原處接續。

i14.en: Enter your player count, chips, and target length. You get a casino-style structure with breaks.
i14.zh-Hant: 輸入人數、籌碼與預計時長，就得到含休息的賭場式結構。

i16.en: Buy-ins, rebuys, and prize splits, calculated on the spot. No spreadsheet at the end of the night.
i16.zh-Hant: 買入、重買與獎金分配當場算好，散場不用開試算表。

i18.en: Give players extra time to decide with a configurable time bank, with warnings and sounds.
i18.zh-Hant: 可設定的 Time Bank 給玩家額外思考時間，有提醒與音效。

i20.en: The current level shows on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island. On a charging iPhone, StandBy shows a full-screen tournament clock.
i20.zh-Hant: 目前級別顯示在鎖定畫面與動態島。iPhone 充電時，StandBy 會顯示全螢幕賽事時鐘。

i22.en: Turn an iPad to landscape for a large countdown with the blinds on either side. The whole table can read it, and the screen stays awake.
i22.zh-Hant: 把 iPad 轉成橫向，就是大字倒數加兩側盲注。全桌都看得到，螢幕也不會休眠。

i24.en: Export any tournament as a .blindclock file and AirDrop it to a friend. They import the same structure with one tap.
i24.zh-Hant: 把賽事匯出成 .blindclock 檔，用 AirDrop 傳給朋友，對方點一下就匯入同一份結構。

i26.en: Your tournament templates sync between iPhone and iPad. Free for everyone.
i26.zh-Hant: 賽事範本在 iPhone 與 iPad 之間同步，所有人免費。

i28b.en: seven themes, including Daylight, the first light theme, change the colors of the whole app. Add your room name and logo on the big screen, and preview every theme for free.
i28b.zh-Hant: 7 款主題（包括第一款亮色主題「日光」）會改變整個 App 的配色。大螢幕可以顯示你的房間名稱與標誌，每款主題都能免費預覽。

i30b.en: count each player’s stack by denomination, save your chip set, and BlindClock checks that the chips entered match the chips in play before anyone leaves.
i30b.zh-Hant: 逐面額清點每位玩家的籌碼，存下你的籌碼結構；散場前，BlindClock 會核對輸入的總碼和場上籌碼是否相符。

i31b.en: the iPad number pad is readable again, the big-screen Time Bank is larger, the current level shows in the top bar, and a What’s New screen appears once after each update.
i31b.zh-Hant: iPad 數字鍵盤恢復可讀，大螢幕的 Time Bank 放大，頂端顯示目前級別，每次更新後會出現一次「新功能」畫面。

i41.en: The free version includes the timer, Live Activity, generator, payouts, table stats, sync, and up to 5 custom tournaments. Pro removes the limit and adds Big Screen Mode, advanced payouts with the settlement assistant, and clock themes & branding. One purchase, on all your devices.
i41.zh-Hant: 免費版包含計時器、即時動態、產生器、獎池計算、牌桌數據、同步，以及最多 5 個自訂賽事。Pro 解除上限，並加入大螢幕模式、獎池計算進階與結算助手、時鐘主題與品牌化。買一次，所有裝置都能用。

i49.zh-Hant: BlindClock 是一款獨立開發的撲克錦標賽盲注計時器（錦標賽時鐘）App，適用於 iPhone 與 iPad。

i5.en: A blind timer for home poker tournaments.
i5.zh-Hant: 家庭撲克錦標賽的盲注計時器。

i51.en: Live table stats: average stack, players left, and big blinds, on the clock screen.
i51.zh-Hant: 即時牌桌數據：平均籌碼、剩餘人數、大盲數，直接顯示在時鐘畫面。

i52.en: BlindClock poker tournament clock with live table stats: blinds, countdown, average stack and players left
i52.zh-Hant: BlindClock 撲克錦標賽時鐘，顯示盲注、倒數與即時牌桌統計：平均籌碼與剩餘人數

i53.en: Enter players, chips, and length. The generator builds the structure.
i53.zh-Hant: 輸入人數、籌碼與時長，產生器就排出結構。

i54.en: Blind structure generator with one-tap level durations and a casino-style blind schedule
i54.zh-Hant: 盲注結構產生器，一鍵選擇級別長度，自動產生賭場風格盲注表

i55.en: Buy-ins and rebuys become a prize pool and payouts.
i55.zh-Hant: 買入與重買直接變成獎池與各名次獎金。

i56.en: Poker payout calculator showing prize pool and instant first, second and third place amounts
i56.zh-Hant: 撲克獎池計算器，顯示總獎池與冠亞季軍即時金額

i58.en: What a clean structure looks like: a turbo runs about 1.5 hours, a standard home game about 3, a deep-stack event 4.5 or more. BlindClock’s generator builds one for your player count, chips, and target length.
i58.zh-Hant: 一份好結構長這樣：快速賽約 1.5 小時，標準家庭局約 3 小時，深籌碼賽事 4.5 小時以上。BlindClock 的產生器會依你的人數、籌碼與目標時長排出一份。

i6.en: Blind levels, breaks, time bank, and payouts. Set it up in a minute, prop up the iPad, and play. No account, no ads, no subscription.
i6.zh-Hant: 盲注級別、休息、Time Bank、獎池分配。一分鐘設定好，把 iPad 立起來就能開打。不用帳號、沒有廣告、沒有訂閱。

i64.en: Blinds are shown as small blind / big blind. Add a 10-minute break every four or five levels. BlindClock’s generator places them for you.
i64.zh-Hant: 盲注以小盲 / 大盲表示。每四到五級加一次 10 分鐘休息，BlindClock 的產生器會自動安排。

i65.en: Read the full guide: how to run a home poker tournament →
i65.zh-Hant: 閱讀完整指南（英文）：如何舉辦一場家庭撲克錦標賽 →

i67.en: Connect to a TV or projector and the big screen shows the tournament clock. Your device works as the remote. A BlindClock Pro feature.
i67.zh-Hant: 接上電視或投影機，大螢幕顯示賽事時鐘，你的裝置當遙控器。BlindClock Pro 功能。

i68.en: Big Screen Mode for TV & projector
i68.zh-Hant: 大螢幕模式（電視/投影機）

p6.en: BlindClock is an independent app. This Privacy Policy applies to the BlindClock iOS application.
p6.zh-Hant: BlindClock 是一款獨立開發的 App。本隱私權政策適用於 BlindClock iOS 應用程式。

pv10.en: The tournaments you build — blind levels, breaks, time-bank settings, sound and screen preferences — are stored locally on your device only, using Apple’s on-device storage. This information is never transmitted to us or to anyone else, and it is removed when you delete the App.
pv10.zh-Hant: 你建立的賽事——盲注級別、休息時段、Time Bank 設定、音效與螢幕偏好——僅透過 Apple 的裝置端儲存機制保存在你的裝置上。這些資訊不會傳送給我們或任何其他人，且會在你刪除本 App 時一併移除。

pv11.en: If your device is signed in to iCloud, your tournament templates are also synced through your private iCloud database (Apple CloudKit) so they appear on your other devices. This data belongs to your Apple Account; we have no access to it, and it is governed by Apple’s Privacy Policy. You can stop syncing by signing out of iCloud or disabling iCloud Drive for the App.
pv11.zh-Hant: 若你的裝置已登入 iCloud，賽事範本也會透過你的私人 iCloud 資料庫（Apple CloudKit）同步，讓它們出現在你的其他裝置上。這些資料屬於你的 Apple 帳號，我們無法存取，並受 Apple 隱私權政策規範。你可以登出 iCloud 或停用本 App 的 iCloud 雲碟來停止同步。

pv13.en: To understand how BlindClock is used and to improve it, the App sends anonymous usage analytics through TelemetryDeck, a privacy-focused analytics service. The data collected is limited to:
pv13.zh-Hant: 為了了解 BlindClock 的使用情形並加以改進，本 App 會透過注重隱私的分析服務 TelemetryDeck 傳送匿名使用分析。收集的資料僅限於：

pv14.en: A non-identifying device identifier — a one-way hashed value used to count unique installations and sessions. It cannot be reversed to identify you, and it is not your Apple ID, phone number, or advertising identifier.
pv14.zh-Hant: 無法識別身分的裝置識別碼——經單向雜湊處理的值，用於統計安裝數與工作階段數。它無法反推出你的身分，也不是你的 Apple ID、電話號碼或廣告識別碼。

pv15.en: Product interaction / usage events — for example: launching the App, starting or finishing a tournament, creating, editing or deleting a tournament template, reaching the free template limit, or viewing the upgrade screen.
pv15.zh-Hant: 產品互動/使用事件——例如：啟動 App、開始或結束一場比賽、建立、編輯或刪除賽事範本、達到免費範本上限、檢視升級頁面。

pv16.en: Basic technical context — such as App version, iOS version, device model, language/region setting, and screen size.
pv16.zh-Hant: 基本技術環境——例如 App 版本、iOS 版本、裝置型號、語言/地區設定與螢幕尺寸。

pv17.en: This data is used solely for analytics (understanding usage and improving the App). It is not linked to your identity and is not used to track you.
pv17.zh-Hant: 這些資料僅用於分析（了解使用情形並改進 App），不會連結至你的身分，也不會用於追蹤你。

pv19.en: No name, email address, phone number, or postal address.
pv19.zh-Hant: 不收集姓名、電子郵件、電話號碼或郵寄地址。

pv2.zh-Hant: 生效日期：2026 年 6 月 11 日

pv20.en: No contacts, photos, calendars, or files.
pv20.zh-Hant: 不存取聯絡人、照片、行事曆或檔案。

pv21.en: No precise location or GPS data.
pv21.zh-Hant: 不收集精確位置或 GPS 資料。

pv22.en: No payment or financial information — purchases of BlindClock Pro are processed entirely by Apple; we never see your payment details.
pv22.zh-Hant: 不收集付款或財務資訊——BlindClock Pro 的購買完全由 Apple 處理，我們不會看到你的付款細節。

pv23.en: No advertising identifier (IDFA) and no advertising of any kind.
pv23.zh-Hant: 不使用廣告識別碼（IDFA），也沒有任何形式的廣告。

pv24.en: No tracking of you across other companies’ apps or websites.
pv24.zh-Hant: 不會跨其他公司的 App 或網站追蹤你。

pv25.en: We never sell, rent, or trade your data.
pv25.zh-Hant: 我們絕不出售、出租或交換你的資料。

pv27.en: Analytics are processed on our behalf by TelemetryDeck GmbH (Germany), acting as our data processor. TelemetryDeck is designed for privacy: it does not build advertising profiles, does not perform fingerprinting or cross-company tracking, and processes data on servers in the European Union. You can read their privacy practices at telemetrydeck.com/privacy.
pv27.zh-Hant: 分析資料由 TelemetryDeck GmbH（德國）以資料處理者的身分代表我們處理。TelemetryDeck 以隱私為設計核心：不建立廣告輪廓、不進行裝置指紋或跨公司追蹤，且資料於歐盟境內的伺服器處理。其隱私做法請參閱 telemetrydeck.com/privacy。

pv29.en: Because BlindClock does not track you across apps or websites and does not use the advertising identifier, the App does not ask for App Tracking Transparency permission.
pv29.zh-Hant: 由於 BlindClock 不會跨 App 或網站追蹤你，也不使用廣告識別碼，因此本 App 不需要、也不會請求「App 追蹤透明度」權限。

pv3.en: BlindClock (the “App”) is a poker tournament blind timer for iPhone and iPad, published by globetrotter-studio (“we”, “us”). We built BlindClock to be useful without being nosy. This policy explains exactly what limited data the App handles, and — just as importantly — what it does not.
pv3.zh-Hant: BlindClock（下稱「本 App」）是一款適用於 iPhone 與 iPad 的撲克錦標賽盲注計時器，由 globetrotter-studio（下稱「我們」）發行。我們希望 BlindClock 好用，但絕不窺探。本政策完整說明本 App 處理哪些有限的資料，以及——同樣重要的——不處理哪些資料。

pv31.en: The anonymous analytics described above are retained by TelemetryDeck in aggregated form in accordance with their data-retention practices. Because the data is not linked to your identity, it cannot be tied back to you individually.
pv31.zh-Hant: 上述匿名分析資料由 TelemetryDeck 依其資料保存規範以彙整形式保存。由於資料未連結至你的身分，無法回溯對應到任何個人。

pv33.en: BlindClock is not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect data from children. If you believe a child has provided us with information, please contact us and we will address it.
pv33.zh-Hant: BlindClock 並非以 13 歲以下兒童為對象，我們也不會明知而收集兒童的資料。若你認為有兒童向我們提供了資訊，請與我們聯絡，我們將立即處理。

pv35.en: You can stop all analytics collection at any time by deleting the App from your device. Depending on where you live, you may have rights under laws such as the GDPR or CCPA (for example, to access or delete personal data). Because our analytics are anonymous and not linked to your identity, we generally cannot single out an individual’s data — but if you have any questions or requests, please reach out using the contact details below.
pv35.zh-Hant: 你隨時可以刪除本 App 來停止所有分析資料的收集。依你所在地區，你可能享有 GDPR 或 CCPA 等法律賦予的權利（例如存取或刪除個人資料）。由於我們的分析資料為匿名且未連結身分，通常無法單獨識別特定個人的資料——但如有任何疑問或請求，歡迎透過下方聯絡方式與我們聯繫。

pv37.en: We may update this policy from time to time. When we do, we will revise the “Effective date” at the top of this page. Significant changes will be reflected here before they take effect.
pv37.zh-Hant: 我們可能不時更新本政策。更新時，我們會修改本頁頂部的「生效日期」。重大變更會在生效前於本頁公布。

pv39.en:
If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, you can contact us at:

pv39.zh-Hant:
若你對本隱私權政策有任何疑問，請聯絡：

pv5.en: No account, no sign-in, no personal details required.
pv5.zh-Hant: 不需帳號、不需登入、不需提供任何個人資料。

pv6.en: Your tournament templates and settings stay on your device (and, if you use iCloud, in your private iCloud account).

pv9.zh-Hant: 1. 儲存在你裝置上的資訊

s10.en: What does BlindClock Pro include, and is it a subscription?
s10.zh-Hant: BlindClock Pro 包含什麼？是訂閱制嗎？

s11.en: Pro is a one-time purchase, not a subscription. The free version includes everything you need to run a game, plus up to 5 custom tournaments. Pro removes that limit and adds Big Screen Mode, advanced ICM payouts with chip counting, and clock themes & branding, on all devices signed in with your Apple Account.
s11.zh-Hant: Pro 是一次性買斷，不是訂閱。免費版已包含主持牌局需要的功能，並可建立最多 5 個自訂賽事。Pro 解除這個上限，並加入大螢幕模式、ICM 獎池進階與籌碼清點、時鐘主題與品牌化，同一 Apple 帳號的裝置都能用。

s12.en: I bought Pro but it shows as locked. How do I restore my purchase?
s12.zh-Hant: 已購買 Pro 但顯示未解鎖，如何恢復購買？

s13.en: Open the upgrade screen (tap the Pro banner on the home screen) and tap “Restore Purchases”. The device must be signed in with the same Apple Account you used to buy Pro.
s13.zh-Hant: 打開升級畫面（點首頁的 Pro 橫幅），再點「恢復購買」。裝置必須登入購買 Pro 時使用的同一個 Apple 帳號。

s15.en: Your custom tournaments sync through your private iCloud account. No setup is needed. Both devices must be signed in to the same Apple Account with iCloud Drive turned on. If you are not signed in to iCloud, the app keeps everything on the device. The running clock does not sync between devices, only your saved tournaments.
s15.zh-Hant: 自訂賽事會透過你的私人 iCloud 帳號同步，不需要設定。兩台裝置必須登入同一個 Apple 帳號並開啟 iCloud 雲碟。若沒有登入 iCloud，App 會把資料留在裝置上。進行中的時鐘不會跨裝置同步，只有已儲存的賽事會。

s16.en: How do I share a tournament with a friend?
s16.zh-Hant: 如何把賽事分享給朋友？

s17.en: Swipe left on a tournament in your list and tap the share icon to export it as a .blindclock file. Send it by AirDrop, Messages, or any other app. When your friend opens the file, BlindClock shows a preview and imports it with one tap.
s17.zh-Hant: 在列表中的賽事上向左滑，點分享圖示，就會匯出成 .blindclock 檔。可以用 AirDrop、訊息或其他 App 傳送。朋友打開檔案時，BlindClock 會顯示預覽，點一下就匯入。

s18.en: The Live Activity doesn’t appear on my Lock Screen.
s18.zh-Hant: 鎖定畫面上沒有出現 Live Activity。

s19.en: Check Settings → BlindClock and make sure Live Activities are allowed. You can also turn the lock-screen banner on or off from the in-app settings while a tournament is running. On iPhone 14 Pro and later, the current level also appears in the Dynamic Island.
s19.zh-Hant: 檢查「設定」→「BlindClock」，確認已允許即時動態。賽事進行中也可以在 App 內設定開關鎖定畫面橫幅。iPhone 14 Pro 以後的機型，目前級別也會出現在動態島。

s20.en: How do I keep the screen on during a game?
s20.zh-Hant: 如何讓螢幕在牌局中保持常亮？

s21.en: Turn on “Keep Screen Awake” in the running tournament’s settings. On iPad in landscape, the table display keeps the screen awake by itself. Plug in the device for long sessions.
s21.zh-Hant: 在進行中賽事的設定裡開啟「螢幕常亮」。iPad 橫向的牌桌展示會自動保持螢幕常亮。長時間使用請接上電源。

s22.en: I force-quit the app mid-tournament. Is my game gone?
s22.zh-Hant: 比賽中不小心強制關閉 App，進度會不見嗎？

s23.en: No. BlindClock saves a checkpoint while the clock runs. Reopen the app and it offers to resume the tournament where it left off, with the elapsed time corrected.
s23.zh-Hant: 不會。時鐘運行時 BlindClock 會存檢查點。重開 App 會詢問是否從原處接續，已進行時間會自動校正。

s25.en: BlindClock runs on iPhone and iPad with iOS / iPadOS 18.6 or later, in 12 languages: English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, German, French, Italian, Polish, Portuguese, Spanish, Turkish, and Vietnamese.
s25.zh-Hant: BlindClock 支援 iOS / iPadOS 18.6 以上的 iPhone 與 iPad，提供 12 種語言介面：英文、繁體中文、日文、韓文、德文、法文、義大利文、波蘭文、葡萄牙文、西班牙文、土耳其文與越南文。

s29.en: BlindClock is an independent poker tournament blind timer and tournament clock app for iPhone & iPad.
s29.zh-Hant: BlindClock 是一款獨立開發的撲克錦標賽盲注計時器（錦標賽時鐘）App，適用於 iPhone 與 iPad。

s30.en: How long should poker blind levels be?
s30.zh-Hant: 撲克盲注每級該設多長時間？

s31.en: Use 15–20 minute blind levels for a fast turbo game, 20–30 minutes for a standard home tournament, and 30–45 minutes or more for a deep-stack event. Shorter levels end the night sooner but force more all-ins. Longer levels leave more room for play. BlindClock’s generator picks a level length from your target duration, and you can adjust every level afterwards.
s31.zh-Hant: 快速賽每級 15 到 20 分鐘，標準家庭局 20 到 30 分鐘，深籌碼賽事 30 到 45 分鐘以上。級別越短越早結束，但會逼出更多全下；級別越長越有空間打牌。BlindClock 的產生器會依目標時長選擇級別長度，之後每一級都可以再調。

s32.en: What payout structure should a home tournament use?
s32.zh-Hant: 家庭錦標賽的獎金該怎麼分配？

s33.en: For 10 players or fewer, pay the top three 50/30/20 percent of the prize pool. For 11–20 players, pay four places, roughly 50/25/15/10. A common rule is that about one in five entrants gets paid. BlindClock’s payout calculator applies the split to your buy-ins and rebuys, so the amounts are ready before the final hand.
s33.zh-Hant: 10 人以下付前三名，比例 50/30/20；11 到 20 人付四名，大約 50/25/15/10。常見做法是約每五人有一人領獎。BlindClock 的獎池計算會把比例套到買入與重買上，最後一手之前金額就算好了。

s34.en: How many chips does each player need?
s34.zh-Hant: 每位玩家需要多少籌碼？

s35.en: Plan on about 50 chips per player, with the starting big blind at about 1% of the starting stack. For example, a 5,000 stack with 25/50 blinds gives everyone 100 big blinds. Three or four denominations are enough. Color up the smallest chips once they are no longer needed. BlindClock’s live table stats show the average stack in big blinds, so you know where the game stands.
s35.zh-Hant: 抓每人約 50 枚籌碼，起始大盲約為起始籌碼的 1%。例如 5,000 起始籌碼配 25/50 盲注，每人有 100 個大盲。三到四種面額就夠，最小面額用不到時換成大額籌碼。BlindClock 的即時牌桌數據會顯示以大盲計的平均籌碼，隨時知道牌局進行到哪。

s36.en: How do I create a blind structure?

s37.en: The easiest way is BlindClock’s generator: enter your player count, chips, and target duration, and it builds a casino-style structure with breaks. A good structure raises the blinds by about 25–50% per level and keeps the numbers round. You can edit every level, add breaks, and save the result as a template to reuse or share.
s37.zh-Hant: 最簡單的方法是用 BlindClock 的產生器：輸入人數、籌碼與目標時長，就會排出含休息的賭場式結構。好的結構每級盲注約增加 25 到 50%，數字保持整數。每一級都可以修改、加休息，並存成範本重複使用或分享。

s38.en: How do I show the clock on a TV or projector?
s38.zh-Hant: 如何把時鐘顯示在電視或投影機上？

s39.en: Connect your iPhone or iPad to the screen with AirPlay or a cable (an HDMI adapter works). With BlindClock Pro, the big screen shows a dedicated tournament clock with a large countdown and the blinds, and your device becomes the remote for pausing, skipping levels, and busting players. Disconnecting does not reset the tournament.
s39.zh-Hant: 用 AirPlay 或轉接線（HDMI 轉接器即可）把 iPhone 或 iPad 接上螢幕。搭配 BlindClock Pro，大螢幕會顯示專用的賽事時鐘，有大字倒數與盲注；你的裝置變成遙控器，可以暫停、跳級、淘汰玩家。中斷連線不會重置比賽。

s4.en: BlindClock 2.5 · We usually reply within a few days.
s4.zh-Hant: BlindClock 2.5 · 我們通常會在幾天內回覆。

s42.en: What is an ICM chop and how does BlindClock calculate it?
s42.zh-Hant: 什麼是 ICM 分錢？BlindClock 怎麼計算？

s43.en: When the last players agree to split the remaining prize pool, an ICM (Independent Chip Model) chop divides it by each player’s chip stack. Enter the stacks and BlindClock Pro calculates a settlement that adds up to the pool exactly. You can also set your own payout percentages and save payout templates.
s43.zh-Hant: 當最後幾位玩家同意分掉剩餘獎池，ICM（獨立籌碼模型）分池會依每人籌碼量分配。輸入各家籌碼，BlindClock Pro 會算出總和恰好等於獎池的結算金額。也可以自訂名次百分比，並儲存獎池範本。

s6.en: Questions, bug reports, and feature requests are welcome. Include your app version and device model so we can help faster.
s6.zh-Hant: 歡迎提問、回報問題或提出功能建議。請附上 App 版本與裝置型號，我們能更快處理。

s8.en: I can’t hear the level-change sounds.
s8.zh-Hant: 聽不到級別切換的提示音。

s9.en: BlindClock’s sounds play even when the iPhone silent switch is on, but they use the media volume. Turn the volume up with the side buttons while the app is open, and check that sounds are enabled in the tournament’s settings. When the app is in the background, alerts arrive as notifications, so allow notifications when the app asks.
s9.zh-Hant: BlindClock 的提示音在 iPhone 靜音開關開啟時也會播放，但走媒體音量。App 開著時用側邊按鈕把音量調高，並確認賽事設定中已開啟音效。App 在背景時，提示改由通知送達，所以 App 詢問時請允許通知。

i69.zh-Hant: 時鐘主題與牌桌品牌化

i72.en: Seven themes, from Midnight to Daylight, change the colors of the whole app. Your room name and logo show on the big screen. Preview for free, apply with Pro.
i72.zh-Hant: 從「午夜」到「日光」共 7 款主題，會改變整個 App 的配色。大螢幕顯示你的房間名稱與標誌。免費預覽，Pro 套用。

i74.en: Count stacks by denomination, save your chip set, and check that the chips add up before anyone leaves. A BlindClock Pro feature.
i74.zh-Hant: 逐面額點碼、儲存籌碼結構，散場前確認籌碼總數對得上。BlindClock Pro 功能。

s44.en: Can I change how the clock looks or add my room’s branding?
s44.zh-Hant: 可以更換時鐘外觀，或加上自己牌局的品牌嗎？

s45.en: Yes. BlindClock Pro includes seven clock themes, from dark ones like Midnight and Casino Felt to Daylight, a light theme. A theme changes the colors of the whole app. You can also set a room name and logo that appear on the big screen. Every theme can be previewed for free from the appearance settings. Applying one requires Pro.
s45.zh-Hant: 可以。BlindClock Pro 內建 7 款時鐘主題，從「午夜」、「賭場綠呢」等暗色主題到亮色的「日光」。換主題會改變整個 App 的配色。你也可以設定房間名稱與標誌，顯示在大螢幕上。每款主題都能在外觀設定裡免費預覽，套用需要 Pro。

s46.en: How does chip counting and the settlement check work?
s46.zh-Hant: 籌碼清點與結算核對怎麼用？

s47.en: On the ICM deal screen, tap the chip icon next to a player to count their stack by denomination. BlindClock totals it and fills in their chip count. Save your chip structure (up to 8 denominations) once and reuse it every game. If the tournament has a starting stack set, BlindClock also compares the chips entered with the chips in play and shows any difference before you split the pool.
s47.zh-Hant: 在 ICM 分池畫面，點玩家旁邊的籌碼圖示，就能逐面額清點籌碼。BlindClock 會自動加總並填入該玩家的籌碼數。籌碼結構（最多 8 種面額）存一次，之後每場都能用。若賽事有設定起始籌碼，BlindClock 還會比對輸入的總碼和場上籌碼，分池前顯示差額。
